condition: Since plotly 6.0, figures built from numpy arrays or pandas series serialize their data arrays as base64 {"dtype","bdata"} dicts instead of plain lists in to_json/to_dict output, which breaks code that reads the values back.
workaround: Pin plotly to 5.24.1, or decode the bdata yourself; with plotly.js, use v2.28 or later, which understands bdata.
